package.name: hexa_eyes
package.description: Optional add-on face. An alternative to hexa_display that draws the eyes in 16 greys (4x supersampled, Lanczos-shrunk) using the renderer from eye-animation-cpp, vendored under shared/eyes_core. Same inputs and policy as hexa_display. Never runs beside it: hexa_bringup's face.yaml `backend` picks one. A pure sink of robot state: nothing imports it.
